decisions.reason: The one-tier pyramid uses the firm's core skills and production setup, so keeping it costs little even though it no longer appears prominently on the website.
The music box line is a distant but strategic growth option, and its absence from the website since 2020 signals weaker prospects, but it is not yet clear enough to justify abandoning the flagship.
After four years this distant, low-visibility accessory has shown no evidence of value, so ending this option frees workshop capacity for the core seasonal business and the main music box line.
